state.seed_assertion: An intermittent-fault capture kit should include reusable PLC blocks for first-out capture, transition history and triggered trends.

sentences.1: An intermittent-fault capture kit should include reusable PLC blocks for first-out capture, transition history and triggered trends.
sentences.2: Prepare reusable PLC blocks for first-out capture, transition history and triggered trends.
sentences.3: An intermittent-fault capture kit should include a portable power-quality logger, approved network tap, spare shielded cables and a standard incident form.
sentences.4: The suspect is what the capture is supposed to find, and if you already knew which input to trigger on you would not need the trend.
sentences.5: Transition from spreadsheet to a shared system should occur when duplicate equipment names are created, attachments become disconnected, multiple sites maintain separate copies, follow-up dates are missed, or audits require manual history reconstruction.
sentences.6: The trigger for capturing an intermittent fault should be the trip event itself, not a suspected input, because the capture is supposed to find the actual cause.
sentences.7: Triggering on a suspected input rather than the trip event can cause the capture to freeze many times on normal operation, providing false data.
sentences.8: The first version of this trend triggered on PE_Discharge, because the alarm said jam and the eye was the obvious culprit, and it froze forty times a shift on cartons passing normally.
sentences.9: a useful log should capture the basics of the job, the condition of the asset, and enough follow-up detail to support warranty history, planning, and trend review over time.
sentences.10: Digital drives with built-in oscilloscope tools and triggering capability can capture key data prior to the next fault occurrence for analysis.
sentences.11: When troubleshooting PLC faults, one should collect system data including alarm history, program changes, and trending data before making modifications.
sentences.12: Consistent fields for maintenance type enable differentiation between different categories of work in trend analysis.
